title: Lena and the Deadline
author: U. M. Vasquez
blurb: Felix Oyelaran, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
